# DevDossier

> DevDossier turns any GitHub username into a clean, recruiter-friendly developer profile with an AI-generated narrative.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What DevDossier is and how it works.
- [Generate](/generate): Enter a GitHub username to produce a dossier.
- [Compare](/compare): Compare two GitHub developers side by side.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/login): Existing user sign-in.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a free account.
